payload.blocks: Landing phases 2, 4 and 5 (test retirement) and redoing phase 7 (shared helpers); phases 8, 11 and 10 wait on those.
payload.headline: Widen the dead-Node-deletion plan footprint by 7 files that cite deleted tests or need the dead code?

parts.cause: Land gate log: doc-health dead-reference findings on deleted test paths. I grepped every deleted path against docs/platform current-claim docs. Outside the footprint: docs/platform/agent-mailbox/spec.md, docs/platform/observe/spec.md, docs/platform/agent-coordination/contracts/assignment-run-runresult.md, docs/platform/packaging-distribution/contracts/setup-doctor-registry.md, docs/platform/proposals/documentation-system-unification.md, scripts/check-decision-codes.baseline.json, scripts/executor-model-vectors.mjs. None is in running plan 261124-0004's footprint.

options.cost: About 20 doc lines, 1 baseline line, one deleted script; no src change.
options.does: Add the 7 paths to the plan footprint; the doc edits only repoint a deleted-test mention to its owning Rust test, and phase 7 retires the executor-model vector recorder with its helper and test (Rust executor_model.rs replays the recorded corpus).
options.gain: Phases 2-5 land this week, phase 7 is redone without copied dead code, the plan reaches its outcome.
options.harm: Touches 5 docs and 2 scripts owned by other areas, a few lines each.
options.label: Widen by these 7 files

options.cost: Same doc lines; phase 8 deletes fewer files; a follow-up item for the rest.
options.does: Leave those docs untouched in meaning, append the last commit where each test existed so doc-health exempts the line, and keep the recorder by keeping the dead modules it imports.
options.gain: No footprint change for the docs.
options.harm: Docs keep claims about tests that no longer exist; the recorder keeps ~10 dead modules alive, so the outcome (dead closure deleted) is only partly met.
options.label: Pin a commit instead

options.cost: New plan later; rework of the waiting branches.
options.does: Land only what fits the current footprint and close the plan as partial; open a new item for the rest.
options.harm: Most of the deletion and its test retirement does not land; done work in 3 branches is left waiting.
options.label: Stop after phase 3

parts.recommendation: Widen by these 7 files: each edit is a mechanical repoint or a deletion the plan's outcome already implies, and nothing overlaps another running plan.

scope.allows: Adding exactly these 7 paths to the plan footprint, editing only the lines that name a deleted test or retiring the recorder script.
scope.forbids: Any other footprint change, any src or Rust code change in those areas, and any edit to files owned by plan 261124-0004.

parts.what: Phases 2-5 deleted ~70 test files of dead Node modules. Their lands fail the doc-health gate because current platform docs still name the deleted tests, and some of those docs are outside the plan footprint. Phase 7 copied ~560 lines of dead builder/resolver code into test/helpers (forbidden), and its redo needs to retire the vector recorder scripts/executor-model-vectors.mjs, which is also outside the footprint.
